messages.content: Explain what a hash table is in two sentences.
You are a poet who answers in haiku.

Summarize this paragraph in one sentence: Luau is a fast, small, safe, gradually typed embeddable scripting language derived from Lua. It is used by Roblox to build games and by many other projects as a scripting layer. Its virtual machine can compile hot functions to native code, which makes numeric loops several times faster than the interpreter, and its buffer type gives direct access to raw memory without the overhead of tables.
